apps.description: Guests book a table on your own page (from Instagram, Google Maps or your website): they pick a day, how many they are and a time, and inside your rules the table is theirs at once, with the smallest free table that fits. Each guest gets a link to confirm, change or cancel. At the door, Today is the service sheet: who comes, at what time, how many, at which table, with notes and allergies, and Arrived or No-show on each row; a walk-in or a phone booking is one button. Guests build up by themselves (visits, no-shows, VIPs), or import them from TheFork, CoverManager or Quandoo. Sources shows where bookings come from and estimates the commission you avoided. Optional: confirmations and reminders through your Gmail or your Resend, and an agent that reads booking emails in Gmail and books them for you.
